points.quote: **`framework/`** holds the four core packages ... **`affine/`** builds the actual Affine editor on the framework. ... it depends only on `framework/`.
`store/` is the Yjs-backed document model, covering blocks, schemas and transactions.
`std/` is the runtime that sits on top of the others. It handles block views, selection, input, commands and canvas rendering.

`blocks/` has the block types ... `widgets/` has the UI around the editor, for both page and edgeless modes. ... `fragments/` has the sidebar and title pieces. ... `block-suite-editor/` and `editors/` are React wrappers around the Lit editor elements.
`block-suite-editor/` and `editors/` are React wrappers around the Lit editor elements.
The view and store extensions are separate so the document model can be used without the UI.
BlockSuite lives in `blocksuite/`. It has about 2,700 files and imports nothing from outside itself.
